title: Banister pistol-whips Jack Martin
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Banister pistol-whips Jack Martin, about 1963 at New Orleans, Louisiana, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> But Banister and Jack Martin got into a a fist fight over the assassination.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author introduced on Jesse Michels' podcast as a CIA historian, tells of two men in New Orleans in 1963, Guy Banister and Jack Martin. He says they got into a fist fight over the assassination, and in the story Banister pistol-whips Martin. Those who tell it see it as a sign that the men around Banister were caught up in talk of the killing.
